summary: ADVOKAT ARILD ALMKLOV (org. no. 995 102 218) is a sole proprietorship (ENK) based in Tønsberg, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2010-02-01. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 69.100 (Juridisk tjenesteyting). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 1.8 m and net income was NOK 1.1 m. Auditor: ENTER REVISJON AS.
